name: settings
title: Settings
description: Settings area: header, a SideNav of setting categories, and a main column of settings-page-sections.

frame.summary: Dashboard's shell; the rail lists setting categories. Main column holds stacked settings-page-sections (Cards).

regions.name: rail

budget.narrow: hidden — categories become the root list

regions.collapse: On narrow: the category list IS the page; choosing one pushes its sections (stacked navigation).

regions.name: main
regions.purpose: h1 = category; settings sections; danger zone last.

components.name: breadcrumbs
components.for: Settings › Security on narrow, as the way back to the category list.

behavior.summary: Each category is its own URL; the rail marks it current.

decisions.why: They are destinations with URLs and a SideNav marks aria-current="page"; Tabs would put every category's form in one document.

decisions.decision: Narrow collapses to stacked navigation, not to a drawer
decisions.why: On a phone the category list is the most useful first screen, which is the native Settings idiom too; hiding it behind a drawer adds a tap.

decisions.decision: Unsaved explicit-mode changes prompt on navigation
decisions.why: settings-page-section exposes `dirty`; only the page can intercept routing.

decisions.decision: Danger zone is the last section and uses Dialog to confirm
decisions.why: Destructive Button + Dialog role=alertdialog, per Dialog's contract; never a Switch.

landmarks.label: implicit; target of the skip link

obligations: First focusable element is a skip link to <main> — there is no skip-link component, so it is VisuallyHidden content that becomes visible on :focus-visible (open question: promote to a component).
On narrow, the category list screen has its own h1 ("Settings").

steps.change: Root: category list (SideNav rendered as the page content). Child: sections with a back link/breadcrumbs.

native.mapping: Root screen: grouped list of categories; each pushes a screen of grouped sections (settings-page-section → list sections).
native.android: PreferenceScreen hierarchy / Compose list with category headers.

tokenGaps.need: Named breakpoints (narrow/medium/wide) as tokens or documented constants
tokenGaps.interim: The block is intrinsic (auto-fill grid, flex-wrap) and needs none. Where a step is unavoidable the page owns the query, as the playground owns its single 60rem NARROW query in use-media-query.ts.
Composed from visually-hidden; every template needs one, which is the argument for making it a component.

tokenGaps.need: A z-index / layer scale for the sticky header
tokenGaps.interim: The playground uses z-index: 1 with a comment; templates do the same until a layer token exists.
